description: This file defines a generic Factory interface with a method to obtain an instance of a specified type, potentially using an optional argument. It serves as a base interface to be extended for creating various factory implementations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Factory
classes.description: A generic factory interface for creating instances of type R with an optional argument of type A.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of type R, potentially using an object of type A as a parameter.
